The FloPlast uPVC round stop end outlet provides an essential connection for guttering systems, effectively terminating a gutter run and directing rainwater into a downpipe. Constructed from durable white uPVC, this 112mm x 68mm component offers a practical and easy-to-install solution, making it suitable for both new-build installations and the refurbishment of existing rainwater drainage. Its design ensures good flow capacity, compatible with 112mm round gutters and 68mm downpipes. Featuring pre-lubricated seals and a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip system, it simplifies assembly and provides a reliable connection for external rainwater management systems.
